title: kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv has no tested row for the backlog-tool rules of SP-q5ldd25k, so their packs read weak or none though backlog.md and tools.md answer them
goal: kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv holds a tested row, expected article and verdict good, for each of these questions asked as the sprint asks them: which history the moved-or-deleted touch rule of backlog.py check reads (backlog.md Sprints, a touches path follows the file); how a link touch under .claude/ is read (backlog.md, the plugin file is edited directly, no staging copy); how land's undelivered warning names the failed gate and its first error line (backlog.md Landing, bl_land.last_push_failure); which paths are always in scope (backlog.md Working on items, kb/_self/backlog/**); who commits an item file answered with --root WORKTREE (backlog.md Running a sprint); whether a manual querylog.py apply --push writes distill.log (querylog.md Delivery); and python3 _tools/rag.py eval passes. A tested row is a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): the item lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS.

run: import sys; t=open('kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv',encoding='utf-8').read(); sys.exit(0 if 'undelivered' in t else 1)

repro_reason: the defect is a pack verdict on a question worded as the sprint asks it; a command that exits non-zero for it would restate the eval row the fix adds
